calls.reason: The stall inference is explicitly tentative. Microsoft's later comparison implies about $16.6 billion for March 2025, but the packet does not settle whether an updated figure was public before the post.

Salesforce and METR document substantial reliability failures alongside successful workflows. Leni reports architectural gains, but these mixed findings do not settle the sweeping claim that agents are unworkable.
The cited Apple paper reports verified multistep solutions and stronger performance at intermediate complexity. Its failures on harder puzzles do not prove that reasoning models cannot reason.
Office Watch documents intrusive Copilot prompts, while the UK government trial reports positive sentiment. Neither establishes how most affected Word and Excel users felt.
CNBC reports about $5 billion in OpenAI losses for 2024, but provides no consumer ChatGPT costs or losses. Company-wide losses alone do not establish the product claim.
SoftBank reports a completed $22.5 billion investment in December 2025. The packet therefore does not test whether OpenAI would fail without the stated annual funding.
